title: Facebook page leads to Michael Johnson
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Facebook page leads to Michael Johnson, about 2026 at South Carolina, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: a fan of the show, shout out Jason Miller, hit us up with a Facebook page, a page just sitting there, and lo and behold, it was for a 70some yearear-old Michael Johnson living in South Carolina

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in 2026 a fan of his show named Jason Miller sent him a Facebook page that had just been sitting there online. According to Michels, the page belonged to Michael Johnson, a man in his seventies living in South Carolina. Michels tells the story in an episode about Air Force veterans who say they were taken by aliens, as the way he tracked down someone he wanted to find.
